messages.content:
Risk: Regulatory compliance failure
Description: The AI system may fail to comply with existing or emerging regulations and standards, potentially leading to legal penalties,fines, or operational restrictions.
Concern: None
Policy: Compliance & Sanctions Evasion

Candidate ontology classes:
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#AlgorithmicDiscrimination: Algorithmic Discrimination — Systematic bias in automated decision-making systems that disadvantages specific groups based on protected characteristics. [found by 3/6 queries]
  Siblings: Employment Discrimination, Discriminatory Denial of Service, Housing Discrimination
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#DirectIdentifierExposure: Direct Identifier Exposure — Disclosure of information that directly identifies individuals, such as names, addresses, government identifiers, or biometric data. [found by 2/6 queries]
  Siblings: Unauthorized Surveillance, Health Data Exposure, Employment Data Exposure
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#ContentSafetyHazard: Content Safety Hazard — Root class for content safety harm categories relevant to adversarial prompt generation against LLM deployments. [found by 2/6 queries]
- https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/FBC/FunctionalEntities/RegulatoryAgencies/RegulationIdentificationScheme: regulation identification scheme — a scheme for organizing information and allocating identifiers to regulations [found by 2/6 queries]
  Siblings: driver's license identification scheme, tax identification scheme, national identification number scheme
- https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/FBC/FunctionalEntities/RegulatoryAgencies/RegulatoryCapacity: regulatory capacity — the capacity of some natural person to regulate some industry, organization, or product by virtue of some certification program on behalf of some regulatory agency [found by 2/6 queries]
  Siblings: contractual capability, delegated legal authority, signatory capacity
- https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/FBC/FunctionalEntities/RegulatoryAgencies/RegulationIdentifier: regulation identifier — an identifier associated with a regulation [from restriction: hasMember on RegulationIdentificationScheme]
  Siblings: merchant identifier, birth certificate identifier, geographic region identifier

axes.rationale: The regulation identification scheme is directly related to the identification and organization of regulations, which is central to the risk of regulatory compliance failure.
Regulatory capacity refers to the ability of entities to enforce regulations, which is crucial in understanding who is responsible for ensuring compliance and who can impose penalties for failures.
